cancellationPolicy: Bookings can be cancelled free of charge any time before check-in. Refunds for paid bookings are processed within 5-7 business days.
petPolicy: Pets are not currently allowed on the property.
smokingPolicy: StayEase is a smoke-free property. Smoking is only permitted in designated outdoor areas.
idRequirement: A valid government-issued photo ID is required at check-in for all guests.
childPolicy: Children of all ages are welcome. Extra bedding for children can be requested via special requests at booking.
